# CANDIDATE: EOD_FLATTEN_EXIT_LOGGING_FIX

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The EOD-flatten exit logging gap causes filled SPY put trades to lack ledger exit records, preventing proper P&L realization and distorting engine performance metrics. Fixing this gap will ensure automatic exit capture at EOD (or time stop), allowing the engine to log exits and realize P&L as intended, thereby improving edge capture on J anchor days.

## Mechanism

Modify the exit manager or heartbeat to trigger a ledger exit record when the EOD flatten condition is met (time = 15:50 ET or daily loss kill switch hit). The exit price will be derived from the last available tick (e.g., 15:49:59 ET bar close) to simulate market-on-close execution. This ensures every position closed by the flatten mechanism writes a corresponding exit record to decisions.jsonl and updates position state, enabling accurate P&L attribution.
